duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
duas.meaning: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.translit: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.
duas.meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.translit: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.
duas.meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
In the name of Allah. If you forget at the start, say: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu (In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end).

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.translit: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
duas.meaning: Praise is to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me, without any power or strength from myself.
duas.virtue: Whoever says this will have his previous sins forgiven.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.translit: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
duas.virtue: It is said to the one who says this: you are guided, defended and protected.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.translit: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna.
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust. Then greet your family with salam.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.translit: Bismillah, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith.
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female unclean spirits.

duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.translit: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh.
duas.meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
duas.virtue: The eight gates of Paradise are opened for the one who says this after wudu; he may enter by whichever he wishes.

duas.meaning: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (×3)  اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.translit: Astaghfirullah (x3). Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
duas.meaning: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour. Then say SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar 33 times each.

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.translit: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.
duas.meaning: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have it by our efforts. And indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.

titles.en: Good in this world and the next

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.translit: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.translit: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
duas.meaning: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
